newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market is closed on Wednesday for the Buddhist Wesak day observance. The market reopens on Thursday, May 22.
On Tuesday, Malaysian rubber prices fell after tracking a weak Tokyo futures market and on absence of buying interest.
At the close, RSS1 buyer for June fell 1.50 cents to 277.50 cents ($1.11) a tonne. SMR 20 buyer for June fell one cent to 262.50 cents.
